errorCodes.meaning: This election is already registered here with another manifest digest or voting key; a registered manifest never changes (VTI-VOT-013).
The manifest's secrecy level is not served by this version (0.1 serves `open` only).
The manifest is well-formed but cannot be run: it names another ballot box, its times are out of order, or a question cannot be answered as specified.

DigestMultibase.description:
A cryptographic digest as a multibase-encoded multihash — the encoding the W3C Verifiable Credentials Data Model 2.0 defines for `digestMultibase`, and the one `did:webvh` uses for its SCID and entry hashes.

Multihash carries the hash algorithm in-band, so the value is self-describing and the wire format survives an algorithm change without a schema revision; multibase does the same for the base encoding, so a verifier never infers base58 from base64url by context. A bare hex string or a `sha-256:`-style prefix hard-codes one algorithm into the wire contract and is non-conforming here.

This definition constrains the *encoding only*. What the digest is computed over is stated by each referencing field, because it differs legitimately: a digest over a JSON document is taken over its RFC 8785 (JCS) canonicalization, while a digest over an opaque artifact is taken over its bytes. A field whose input is a JSON document and which does not name a canonicalization is not reproducible.

Restricted to the two multibase headers W3C Controlled Identifiers 1.0 §2.4 normatively requires — `z` (base58btc) and `u` (base64url-no-pad). CID permits others but states that "interoperability is not guaranteed between implementations using such values", and a registry whose purpose is interoperability should not mint digests a conforming verifier may be unable to read. The alphabets are enforced rather than assumed: base58btc excludes 0, O, I and l, and an earlier permissive pattern let three published examples carry digests that were not valid base58 at all. base58btc is RECOMMENDED, for consistency with `did:key` and `did:webvh`.
DigestMultibase.title: DigestMultibase

ElectionId.title: ElectionId

ballotsAdmitted.description: Distinct tags with a counted ballot.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

Key.description: A question or option key, unique within its manifest or question.
Key.title: Key

Manifest.description: What an election asks and how it is decided (VTI-VOT-010). Its digest (`manifestDigest`) is the SHA-256 multihash of its RFC 8785 (JCS) canonicalization, and every cast is bound to it (VTI-VOT-011).

ballotBox.description: The DID of the voting service that holds the board.

binding.description: Whether the community treats the result as deciding something; creating a binding election takes another administrator's consent (VTI-VOT-081).

resultsBeforeClose.description: Open elections only: whether running totals may be read while voting is open (VTI-VOT-061).

textReleaseThreshold.description: Counted ballots required before any text answer is disclosed (VTI-VOT-065).

Manifest.title: Manifest

Multibase.description: A binary value, multibase base58btc over the suite's canonical (compressed) encoding.
Multibase.title: Multibase

oneOf.description: Select between `minSelections` and `maxSelections` of `options`. A yes/no/abstain motion is a choice of exactly one of three.
oneOf.title: ChoiceQuestion

oneOf.description: Order `options`; a ballot ranks every option or, when `partial` is true, a prefix of them.
oneOf.title: RankingQuestion

oneOf.description: Give each option an integer score within [min, max].
oneOf.title: ScoreQuestion

oneOf.description: Free text of at most `maxLength` characters.
oneOf.title: TextQuestion

label.description: Display text. Absent from a manifest registered with a ballot box that holds no question text (VTI-VOT-014).

Revote.description: What a later, different ballot under one ticket does: `replace` the earlier one, or be refused (`refuse`) (VTI-VOT-041).
Revote.title: Revote

RollRule.description: Who may be issued a ticket (VTI-VOT-021): the community's active members, its active members and the parties `listed` names, or only the parties `listed` names.
RollRule.title: RollRule

SecrecyLevel.description: `open`: ballots are recorded on the board as cast. `sealed`: ballots are encrypted to a jointly generated election key and decrypted after voting closes. `talliedEncrypted`: ballots are encrypted and only the totals are ever decrypted (VTI-VOT-060). The encrypted levels are cast with `voting/ballot/cast-encrypted/0.1`, under an election key the trustees generate with `voting/trustees/*` (CONVENTIONS §9).
SecrecyLevel.title: SecrecyLevel

Trustees.description: The trustees of a sealed or tallied-encrypted election and the number of them decryption needs (VTI-VOT-062). Neither the community nor the ballot box may be one.
Trustees.title: Trustees

VotingParameters.description: The community's published voting parameters: the PCS suite and the voting verification key tickets are issued under (VTI-VOT-020). Distinct from its hidden-vetting helper key.
VotingParameters.title: VotingParameters

schema.description: A community registers an election it signed with the ballot box the election's manifest names. The ballot box answers with its view of the election.

community.description: The community's DID. Equal to the proven signer and to `manifest.community`.

manifestDigest.description: The SHA-256 multihash of the RFC 8785 (JCS) canonicalization of `manifest`, as the community computed it.

parameters.description: The community's voting parameters: the key the election's tickets are issued under, which every cast's attestation is checked against.
